name: Date Property Alerts
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Adds a filtered Bases alert view for note date properties, local delivery history, and optional Pro snooze.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Each due note gets a notice, and the notices that you clicked are remembered on this device.
Snooze 15 minutes is free. Pro adds one hour, one day and a custom snooze.
tip: Embed the base in a daily note and pick its Alerts view. Alerts then run while that note is open.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Date Property Alerts is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep track of your dates.
